text_block_list.text:
The gym today is filled with a strange
sort of
excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Good. I'm in perfect communication with
my
triceps. Everything's in tip-top
condition.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do it today!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Did you hear?! Ryan's gonna challenge
the heavy
barbells!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: The ones nobody can lift? That might be impossible even for her...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Haha, don't you worry!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
My exceptional muscles don't know the
meaning
of "impossible"!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Yeah, Ryan! You can do it!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text: Eight... nine! Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Just one more rep to complete three
sets! She
really might do it!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
...But she's struggling! Come on, stay
strong,
Ryan!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: ...YAH!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Muscles... make it possible!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Wow... I've never seen
anything
like that!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Haha, thank you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could show everyone that
nothing's out
of reach if you have
well-toned muscles!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ngh! My arms...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: That was a nice attempt, Ryan!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you! But it looks like I still
have some
work left to do.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to train harder. And then I'll
show you
all the true potential of
muscle!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Although she failed at lifting the
weights, Mejiro
Ryan seems to have
grown even more from the
experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After lifting the heaviest weights, it
seems like
Мэдзиро Райан has grown even
more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
